verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs show it ingests traces and logs in one platform via OTLP. They also show a Trace Explorer for querying spans, dashboards for navigating error and performance data, and an AI agent (Seer) that draws on tracing data, logs, and profiles together. That covers roughly half the story: metrics collection is not evidenced, and analyst-driven pivoting between signals with shared context is only implied. missing for 10: documented metrics ingestion, explicit cross-signal pivoting (logs↔traces↔metrics via shared trace context in the UI), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints
You can explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
It uses Sentry's rich context (issue details, tracing data, logs, and profiles) to help you troubleshoot and fix errors and performance issues faster.
allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects
